issue_request: FHIR-17023 is a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for FHIR-core Binary asking to change wording from "when the content is already binary - XDS" to "when the content is already binary - e.g. XDS" so XDS is understood as an example.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-17023 was found. The Jira comment says "already fixed", and nearby Aug. 2, 2018 Binary commits show GF#16880 changing the target "- XDS" wording to "e.g. in some uses of IHE XDS" and GF#16076 linking the XDS reference.
additional_context: Binary is active in source/fhir.ini. Later GF#19250 source refactoring merged Media guidance into DocumentReference guidance and replaced the old Media-preferred image sentence with an IHE XDS implementation-guide pointer. The current Binary introduction lists multiple Binary content examples and does not present XDS as the only binary-content case.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Re-adding local "e.g." wording would either duplicate current examples or revive a removed Media-specific sentence.
